build_epsilon_greedy_ranker: build an epsilon greedy ranker operator with a given epsilon value and seed for iterative ranking
build_softmax_ranker: build a softmax ranker operator with a temperature parameter and optional seed for iterative ranking
build_frechet_ranker: build a Frechet ranking operator with rho, gamma parameters and an optional seed value
build_ucb_operator: build an UCB algorithm operator with a specified method and configurable batch size
build_expression_operator: build an expression operator that evaluates calculations based on a given equation string
